title: The Snow and the End of Mortal Life
summary: Endless snow falls on the Four Faction Alliance, turning the mortal world to ice, and Zhou Wutai visits Wang Lin after more than ten years to admire his carving of Qing Song's Age Intent Realm, refuse it, and give him a jade slip holding a Soul Formation technique. He explains that the snow is an attack by the Snow Region, a level-4 cultivation country in the far north, and invites Wang Lin to join the Alliance; Wang Lin declines. Three Heihun Sect elders, You Kong, You Huan and You Mei, try to kill him with the Ink Bone Sword Formation, and he breaks it alone. The old man tells him the war is over the Rain Cauldron, which opens the gates of the shattered Ancient Immortal Realm, whose remaining immortal energy is the only path from Soul Formation to Soul Transformation without a Soul Transformation Pill. Thinking over his life of killing and his thirty years as a mortal, Wang Lin grasps that death is himself and life is also himself, saves the freezing Zeng family by carrying them to a neighbouring country, and ends his time as a mortal.
